search_method.order: Supplied main papers, Mo supplement and existing extractions; cited primary papers; targeted wider searches; DOI registry checks.
representative_queries: "Modelling of fluid flow distribution in multichannel ceramic membrane"
"Effect of cross-flow velocity, oil concentration and salinity"
search_method.evidence_policy: Technical screening relies on primary publisher records, university-hosted articles and author-hosted review; secondary search hits are discovery leads only.
search_method.access_limits: Publisher full-page requests often returned 403. Indexed publisher text supports screening, not inspected table cells or extracted curve values. No paywall or institutional authentication was bypassed.
search_method.metadata_limits: Some registry titles omit subscripts or punctuation. Later Crossref 429 responses were not retried; initial Garcia metadata was inspected but not saved as a response file.

decision.first_model: Bounded source-specific critical-flux constraint at fixed target flux, coupled to module hydraulics and DWSIM duty.
decision.inference: Full supplied text and selected figures now reviewed; a bounded reference benchmark is feasible. Physical absolute-flow calibration is not established.
do_not_infer: A sustainable long-term flux from short-step critical flux alone
A fitted velocity law from a single fixed-velocity experiment
An effect of support geometry on fouling from hydraulic resistance alone
decision.acquisition_status: All four requested papers received as Markdown, metadata and figures; no additional article required now. Original PDFs optional for source typography audit.
decision.next_executable_step: Define an explicit synthetic star-channel geometry/flow convention and verify its OpenLB hydraulics using stock facilities. Biological feed remains a separate lower-flux case.

data_contract.unavailable_inputs: Null or explicit scenario with sensitivity; no new laboratory measurements, inaccessible raw data, extra repositories or author contact required.
data_contract.velocity: Distinguish inlet versus mean channel velocity; Q/A_open; filtration area differs from open cross-section.
data_contract.energy: Distinguish published energy boundary from two-pump shaft energy per permeate volume and any electrical/cooling duties.
data_contract.feed: New suspension properties and concentration/rejection balances needed before claiming validated recycle behavior.
